faq.q: Which areas does the page say Jared serves?
faq.a: South Surrey, White Rock and the Fraser Valley, with the FAQ naming Morgan Creek, Grandview Heights, Elgin Chantrell, Crescent Beach & Ocean Park, Sunnyside Park, King George Corridor, Pacific Douglas and Hazelmere — all as the page states them.

faq.q: Can I book a private showing with Jared?
faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.

faq.q: Which areas does Jared Gibbons serve?
faq.a: Jared works across South Surrey, White Rock and Langley, and more broadly the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver, including Surrey, Cloverdale, Delta, Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Mission and Maple Ridge. Call or text 604-928-1361.

faq.q: How long has Jared been a REALTOR®?
faq.a: Jared has been a licensed REALTOR® since 2015, with 11+ years in Fraser Valley real estate, and is with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty.
